ruleDefinitions.name: Credential Dumping Tools Service Execution - System
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects well-known credential dumping tools execution via service execution events Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name, ImagePath

sequences.query: (Provider_Name = "Service\ Control\ Manager" AND event_id = 7045 AND (ImagePath = RGX(".*cachedump.*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*dumpsvc.*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*fgexec.*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*gsecdump.*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*mimidrv.*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*pwdump.*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*servpw.*")))
